summary: @or-sdk/pgsql preinstall downloads Bun and executes an obfuscated sibling payload
details: The package's preinstall script (`node setup.mjs`) downloads the Bun runtime from GitHub releases, chmods it executable, and invokes it against a sibling file `math_init.js`. `math_init.js` is a ~727KB heavily obfuscated JavaScript blob (hex-mangled identifiers, large numeric/string constant arrays, decoder-function packing typical of obfuscator.io-style tooling) whose filename does not correspond to the package's advertised PostgreSQL SDK purpose. The preinstall loader `setup.mjs` is itself obfuscated with identifier mangling (`_0x488df8`, `_0x52943e`,...) and indirect-call trampoline objects. Fetching Bun specifically so a Node-based scanner cannot statically evaluate the payload, together with the cover-story filename and mutual obfuscation of loader and payload, is the alternate-runtime dropper pattern: `npm install` runs opaque author-controlled code on the installer's machine with the user's privileges.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
